texto: It is formed with the simple conditional of the auxiliary (**avrei** or **sarei**) plus the past participle of the main verb.

With verbs that require **essere** the gender and number concordance is applied: **Sarei venuta volentieri** (would have come with pleasure, woman), **Saremmo partiti presto** (we would have left early). With **avere** the participle ends in **-o**: **Avrei voluto parlare con te**.

filas: I would have been happy to, but I couldn't.
Ti avrei presentato i miei colleghi.
I would have wanted to introduce you, but you didn't come.
Avrei telefonato, ma il telefono era scarico.
I couldn't call because I ran out of battery.
You should have told me in advance.

frases.it: Ieri sera ti ho cercato a lungo al concerto!
frases.es: ¡Ayer por la tarde te busqué durante mucho tiempo en el concierto!
frases.en: I looked for you for a long time at the concert yesterday afternoon!

frases.it: Mi dispiace tanto! Sarei venuta volentieri, ma ho avuto un contrattempo.
frases.es: ¡Lo siento muchísimo! Habría venido con gusto, pero tuve un contratiempo.
frases.en: I'm so sorry! I would have come with pleasure, but I had a setback.
analisis: I would have come with pleasure.

frases.it: Avrei voluto presentarti i miei colleghi di lavoro.
frases.es: Habría querido presentarte a mis compañeros de trabajo.
frases.en: I would have wanted to introduce you to my co-workers.
analisis: I would have wanted to introduce you.

frases.it: Ti avrei chiamato, ma la batteria del telefono era scarica.
frases.es: Te habría llamado, pero la batería del teléfono estaba descargada.
frases.en: I would have called you, but the battery on the phone was unloaded.
analisis: but the battery of the phone

bloques.pregunta: Why didn't Silvia attend the concert with Paolo?

opciones.texto: Because he had an unexpected setback that prevented him from going.
opciones.explicacion: Silvia clarifies: «ho avuto un contrattempo» even though it would have gone with pleasure.

opciones.texto: Because he completely forgot the day and time of the appointment.
opciones.explicacion: He remembered the concert perfectly, but he had an insurmountable obstacle.

opciones.texto: Because he preferred to stay home and rest with his colleagues.
opciones.explicacion: He claims with great strength that he would have participated in a good way.

bloques.frase: Silvia è una donna, quindi dice: «Io ___ venuta molto volentieri».

opciones.explicacion: With an auxiliary «essere» the participle is made of feminine singular: «sarei venuta».
«Venire» is a verb of intransitive movement that requires auxiliary «essere».
He is the first person to plural the simple future («seremos»).

bloques.pregunta: Why didn't the call get made?
bloques.frase: Ti avrei chiamato subito per avvisarti.

opciones.texto: Because his cell phone battery had been completely exhausted.
opciones.explicacion: It explains the technical impossibility of warning in time.

opciones.texto: Because I didn't remember your friend's phone number.
opciones.explicacion: I had the contact, but the device was unloaded.

opciones.texto: Because he decided not to warn him to give him a live surprise.
opciones.explicacion: I wanted to warn you, but the setback stopped him.

bloques.frase: Sarei venuta volentieri ma ho avuto un contrattempo
bloques.traduccion: I would have come with pleasure, but I had a setback.
bloques.explicacion: Expression of frustrated possibility in conditional compound with essere auxiliary.

bloques.pregunta: What cordial reproach does the «Avresti dovuto avvisarmi prima» phrase contain?

opciones.texto: He points out that the other person had a moral obligation to warn in advance.
opciones.explicacion: «Avresti dovuto» formulates a retrospective reproach about a duty neglected.

opciones.texto: It reports that there will be a mandatory work meeting tomorrow.
opciones.explicacion: It refers to a fact already accomplished in the past, not the future.

opciones.texto: He is grateful for sending an urgent message in time.
opciones.explicacion: It points out precisely the lack of timely notice.

bloques.frase: Noi ___ voluto partecipare alla conferenza, ma non abbiamo trovato posto.

opciones.explicacion: Primera persona plural del condicional de «avere» ante el participio modal «voluto».
It is the first person singular («I would have wanted to.»).
The «volere» verb before transient infinitive is regularly conjugated with «avere».

bloques.pregunta: What verbal time is used and what does it denote?
bloques.frase: Avrei voluto presentarti i miei colleghi.

opciones.texto: Composed conditional: denotes a desire that did not materialize in the past.
opciones.explicacion: He expressed the missed opportunity to make the presentation of colleagues.

opciones.texto: Imperfect: denotes a custom they repeated every Friday.
opciones.explicacion: It's not a repeated habit, it's a lost time.

opciones.texto: Future Previous: denotes an action that will happen before next month.
opciones.explicacion: It's about a fact that's already been left behind in time.

intro: The composite conditional (condizionale passato) serves to talk about projects that could not be carried out, lost quotes or past duties neglected.
